agent.notes: The PR changes CoreMemory lookups in PostHog's ee/hogai memory nodes to Django ORM get_or_create calls. Running them needs the full PostHog Django app with a migrated PostgreSQL database; the repo's tests also need ClickHouse. The project install also failed on both sides (setuptools package discovery error). SQLite can't stand in because the models use Postgres-specific fields, and stubbing the ORM would mean patching the code under test.
